title: Hannibal's pass over the Alps
summary: Maps an (illustrative) forum discussion about which pass Hannibal used to cross the Alps: five candidate routes from the Rhône to the Taurini, compared on the same terrain, with the view from the top that Polybius describes.
sources: Illustrative discussion written for this example, not a real thread (sources/hannibal-alps-debate.md)

zh.title: 汉尼拔翻越阿尔卑斯的山口
zh.summary: 把一场（示例性的）论坛讨论画成地图：汉尼拔翻越阿尔卑斯究竟走的是哪个山口？从罗讷河到陶里尼人的五条候选路线，在同一地形上比较，并检验波利比乌斯所说山顶的视野。
sources: 为本例撰写的示例讨论，并非真实帖子（sources/hannibal-alps-debate.md）

places.name: Rhône crossing
places.note: Where the army crossed the Rhône before turning towards the Alps. The exact place is debated; it is shown near Roquemaure.

zh.name: 渡罗讷河处
zh.note: 大军在转向阿尔卑斯山之前渡过罗讷河的地方。确切地点有争议，图中标在罗屈埃莫尔一带。

places.name: Col de la Traversette
places.note: Nearly 3,000 m, beside Monte Viso, between the Guil valley and the head of the Po. In the discussion, geoarch_fan cites a 2016 study of a dung-rich soil layer in a mire below the pass on the French side, dated to around 200 BC. The col's position here is approximate.

zh.name: 特拉韦塞特山口
zh.note: 海拔近3000米，在维索峰旁，连接吉勒河谷与波河源头。讨论中，geoarch_fan 引用2016年的一项研究：山口法国一侧下方沼泽中有一层富含粪便的翻搅土层，年代约在公元前200年。图中山口位置为约略。

places.name: Col du Clapier
places.note: About 2,480 m, reached from the Maurienne (Arc valley) near Bramans. clapier_guy calls it the pass most cited for a view onto the Italian side near the summit. Its position here is approximate and could not be checked against the elevation data, so no view from it is shown. The flat ground to the north-west is the modern Mont Cenis reservoir.

zh.name: 克拉皮耶山口
zh.note: 海拔约2480米，从莫列讷（阿尔克河谷）的布拉芒附近上山。clapier_guy 说这是最常被提到在山顶附近能望见意大利一侧的山口。图中位置为约略，未能用高程数据核实，因此不展示从这里看出去的视野。西北侧那片平地是现代的塞尼山水库。

places.name: Mont Cenis pass
places.note: About 2,080 m. One of the easy crossings that romanroads points to, and a main road into Italy in later centuries.

zh.name: 塞尼山口
zh.note: 海拔约2080米。romanroads 提到的较易通行的山口之一，后世通往意大利的主要道路。

places.name: Little St Bernard
places.note: About 2,190 m, from the Isère (Tarentaise) down into the Aosta valley. A favourite of 19th-century writers, romanroads says, but it comes out far to the north of the Taurini.

zh.name: 小圣伯纳德山口
zh.note: 海拔约2190米，从伊泽尔河（塔朗泰斯）下到奥斯塔河谷。romanroads 说这是19世纪作者最青睐的说法，但出山处远在陶里尼人以北。

places.name: Montgenèvre
places.note: About 1,850 m above Briançon, the lowest of the candidates and later a main Roman road into Italy.

zh.name: 蒙热内夫尔山口
zh.note: 海拔约1850米，在布里扬松之上，是几个候选山口中最低的，后来是罗马人进入意大利的主要道路之一。

places.name: Taurini (Turin)
places.note: Chief town of the Taurini, which Polybius says Hannibal stormed soon after coming down from the Alps.

zh.name: 陶里尼人（都灵）
zh.note: 陶里尼人的主要城镇。据波利比乌斯记载，汉尼拔下山后不久便攻破此城。

places.name: Aosta valley (Salassi)
places.note: Where the Little St Bernard comes down: the land of the Salassi, far north of the Taurini.

zh.name: 奥斯塔河谷（萨拉西人）
zh.note: 小圣伯纳德山口下山之处：萨拉西人的地盘，远在陶里尼人以北。

routes.name: Via Traversette

zh.name: 特拉韦塞特路线
zh.note: 溯迪朗斯河、吉勒河而上，翻越特拉韦塞特山口，再沿波河自源头而下。

routes.note: Up the Durance and the Guil, over the Traversette and down the Po from its source.

routes.name: Via Montgenèvre

zh.name: 蒙热内夫尔路线
zh.note: 溯迪朗斯河至布里扬松，翻越蒙热内夫尔山口，经苏萨沿多拉里帕里亚河而下。

routes.note: Up the Durance to Briançon, over Montgenèvre and down the Dora Riparia by Susa.

routes.name: Via Col du Clapier

zh.name: 克拉皮耶路线
zh.note: 溯伊泽尔河、阿尔克河（莫列讷）而上，翻越克拉皮耶山口下到苏萨。

routes.note: Up the Isère and the Arc (Maurienne), over the Clapier and down to Susa.

routes.name: Via Mont Cenis

zh.name: 塞尼山路线
zh.note: 与克拉皮耶路线一样溯莫列讷而上，但翻越较低的塞尼山口。

routes.note: Up the Maurienne like the Clapier route, but over the lower Mont Cenis.

routes.name: Via Little St Bernard

zh.name: 小圣伯纳德路线
zh.note: 溯伊泽尔河经塔朗泰斯，翻越小圣伯纳德山口，沿奥斯塔河谷而下，再绕到陶里尼人那里。

routes.note: Up the Isère through the Tarentaise, over the Little St Bernard, down the Aosta valley and round to the Taurini.

steps.title: The question
steps.text:
The post starts from the ancient accounts. Polybius says that on the summit Hannibal showed his troops the plains of the Po, with snow already lying on the pass; Livy adds a rockfall on the descent that the men broke up with fire and vinegar.

Five passes come up in the thread. All of them start from the Rhône and end on the Italian side, but they cross the Alps in very different places.

zh.title: 问题
zh.text:
帖子从古代记载说起。波利比乌斯说，汉尼拔在山顶向士兵指点波河平原，以鼓舞士气，当时山口已经积雪；李维又补充说，下山途中遇到落石，士兵用火烧和醋浇把它弄碎。

讨论中提到五个山口。它们都从罗讷河出发、到达意大利一侧，但翻越阿尔卑斯山的位置大不相同。

steps.title: Traversette: high, with evidence
steps.text:
geoarch_fan argues for the Col de la Traversette: up the Durance and the Guil, nearly 3,000 m beside Monte Viso, then straight down the Po from its source. Their evidence is a 2016 study of a dung-rich soil layer in a mire below the pass, dated to around 200 BC.

The profile shows what that climb meant for an army with horses and elephants.

zh.title: 特拉韦塞特：高，但有证据
zh.text:
geoarch_fan 主张特拉韦塞特山口：溯迪朗斯河、吉勒河而上，在维索峰旁翻越近3000米的山口，然后沿波河从源头直下。证据是2016年的一项研究：山口下方沼泽中有一层富含粪便的土层，年代约在公元前200年。

剖面显示了这段爬升对一支带着马和大象的军队意味着什么。

steps.title: Clapier and Mont Cenis: up the Maurienne
steps.text:
clapier_guy objects that the Traversette is too high for elephants late in the year, and argues for the Col du Clapier, reached up the Arc valley (the Maurienne), lower and known for a view onto the Italian side near the summit. romanroads points out that Mont Cenis, next door, is easier still.

Both routes share the long approach up the Isère and the Arc and come down to Susa.

zh.title: 克拉皮耶与塞尼山：溯莫列讷而上
zh.text:
clapier_guy 反驳说，特拉韦塞特对深秋带着大象的军队来说太高了，他主张克拉皮耶山口：从阿尔克河谷（莫列讷）上山，较低，而且以在山顶附近能望见意大利一侧著称。romanroads 指出，旁边的塞尼山口更容易。

两条路线都要先长途溯伊泽尔河、阿尔克河而上，再下到苏萨。

steps.title: Montgenèvre and the Little St Bernard
steps.text: romanroads also raises the two other classic answers. Montgenèvre, above Briançon, is the lowest crossing and later a main Roman road. The Little St Bernard, favoured by many 19th-century writers, goes up the Isère and down the Aosta valley, but it comes out far to the north, among the Salassi, a long way from the Taurini whose town Hannibal took soon after.

zh.title: 蒙热内夫尔与小圣伯纳德
zh.text: romanroads 还提出另外两个经典答案。布里扬松之上的蒙热内夫尔是最低的山口，后来是罗马的主要道路。小圣伯纳德山口受到许多19世纪作者青睐，溯伊泽尔河而上、沿奥斯塔河谷而下，但出山处远在北方的萨拉西人之地，离汉尼拔随后攻取的陶里尼人城镇很远。

steps.title: The five routes side by side
steps.text:
alpine_curious asks what each route would have meant on the ground. The comparison puts all five on the same footing: the same elevation data and the same marching model, from the Rhône crossing to the Taurini.

It shows the trade-off the thread ends on: how much longer, higher or harder each option is, not which one Hannibal took.

analysis.label: Five candidate routes, Rhône to the Taurini

zh.label: 五条候选路线：罗讷河至陶里尼人

zh.title: 五条路线并列
zh.text:
alpine_curious 问，每条路线在实地意味着什么。比较把五条路线放在同一个基础上：同样的高程数据、同样的行军模型，从渡罗讷河处到陶里尼人。

它显示的是讨论最后归结的权衡：每个选项长多少、高多少、难多少，而不是汉尼拔究竟走了哪条。

steps.title: A view of Italy from the top?
steps.text: The viewshed from the Col de la Traversette shows how much of the Italian side a soldier standing on the pass could see, looking down the head of the Po valley that geoarch_fan describes. It is the test the thread applies to Polybius's 'plains of the Po'.

zh.title: 山顶能望见意大利吗？
zh.text: 从特拉韦塞特山口看出去的可视域，显示站在山口上的士兵能看到多少意大利一侧的地面，视线沿 geoarch_fan 所说的波河源头河谷而下。这正是讨论用来检验波利比乌斯“指点波河平原”一说的标准。

steps.title: An open question
steps.text: The thread ends without an answer: the high pass with the physical evidence against the lower, easier passes that later armies used. The map cannot settle it either, but it shows what each choice would have meant: the length of the march, the height of the climb, and where the army would have come down into Italy.

zh.title: 悬而未决
zh.text: 讨论没有得出结论：一边是有实物证据的高山口，一边是后世军队常走的较低、较易的山口。地图也无法定论，但它显示了每种选择意味着什么：行军有多远、要爬多高、大军会从哪里下到意大利。
